dedupe_keys.name: supporting code and data for dale et al community scale urban flood monitoring through fusion of time lapse imagery terrestrial lidar and remote sensing data

description: The urban-flood monitoring team publishes field-event data and processing code that combine time-lapse photographs, terrestrial lidar and remote-sensing layers. Zenodo supplies two data archives, a code archive and a plain README under CC BY 4.0. The README identifies camera calibration and pose routines, point-cloud projection, water-level estimation and depth mapping for comparison with HEC-RAS raster outputs. These materials can calibrate flood-depth observations and validate local inundation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this fusion package. Coverage is the community-scale events and instruments in the describing study, not a continuous flood sensor network. A limitation is that camera geometry, occlusion and lidar registration can affect inferred levels; the authors say code may need changes for other sites. The linked paper is described as accepted, but its final publication details were not checked. No archive was downloaded and no water-level estimate was reproduced.
